note: Load form (research/load-harness.md) for L07, through the trace form's driver (trace/overlay/trace-driver.js, one route per library function), with the host each function calls never answering. The stub counts the calls held open, each second: a call with no deadline stays open for as long as the host hangs, so they pile up with every request; one with a deadline (3 s for the quotes, in the clean twin) is cut off, and at 10 requests a second at most about 30 are open. A twin reports when it holds at least three times the other's open calls, and at least 60. k6 gives up on each request after 4 s, so requests in flight stay bounded on the client side; the calls the twin left open are what is counted. getQuoteHistory has a deadline in both twins: the decoy. Each step runs at a fixed arrival rate (k6), each twin judged against the other over 3 repeats, every finding under the timing rule. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other judged step is a decoy, in both twins.
